website.note: Company website lists PreTRM test (commercial) and LikeMine platform (commercial). No drug pipeline page; references PRIME interventional study (results published Jan 2026).

ctgov.note: ClinicalTrials.gov returns 4 sponsor records, all observational (Phase N/A): NCT02787213 PAPR (Completed), NCT04301518 PRIME (Active, Not Recruiting — observational/post-market), NCT01371019 (Completed), NCT03530332 PREVENT-PTB (Terminated, investigator-led). No interventional drug trials Phase 1/2/3.

products.name: PreTRM Test
products.indication: Prediction of risk of spontaneous preterm birth in asymptomatic singleton pregnancies (blood draw at gestational weeks 18-20)
products.status: Commercially available in the US; reimbursement collaboration with Elevance Health

products.name: LikeMine Platform
products.indication: Pregnancy outcome benchmarking; complimentary Complications Summary Report

development_programs_non_clinical: Stillbirth and time-to-birth biomarker programs (in development)

excluded_preclinical: Preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, stillbirth biomarker programs — in discovery/biomarker development; no IND-equivalent regulatory pathway (diagnostics).
excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT03530332 PREVENT-PTB — Terminated, investigator-led (Ware Branch sponsor).
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Sera Prognostics is a molecular diagnostics company (LDT proteomic biomarker tests for pregnancy). Its lead product PreTRM is a commercial laboratory-developed test, not a drug. All sponsor-led clinical studies on ClinicalTrials.gov are observational (Phase N/A), with the PRIME interventional study (NCT04301518) being a post-market test-utility evaluation. No proprietary drug or biologic in IND-stage Phase 1/2/3 development.
